baseline_models.focus_anchor: The feminine state-change verb at word 1 is completed by the comparison to al-sarim at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse presents a completed transition whose resultant likeness is not generic damage but severance: continuity, attachment, or access has been cut.

activation_trace.role: Becoming into a state supplies the completed transition that governs the comparison.
Severing and discontinuity supply the defining resultant condition rather than a merely damaged appearance.

changed_reading.before: By morning it had become ruined.
changed_reading.after: It entered a state whose essence was cut continuity: what had cohered, flowed, or remained accessible was now severed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The comparison noun at word 2 carries both crop-cutting and a detached or harvested tract of land.
baseline_models.mechanism: The simile can render the unstated subject as though harvesting had already been completed, leaving an emptied tract while withholding the identity of the cutter.

activation_trace.role: Resultant becoming makes the harvested likeness an achieved state rather than an intended action.
Crop-cutting and harvest time supply the concrete agricultural appearance of work already done.
A detached piece including harvested ground supplies the residual field-form left after cutting.

changed_reading.after: It looked like an achieved harvest: an emptied, cut tract whose absent produce presupposes an unshown cutter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 opens morning while word 2 can name night or day as each cuts off the other, including a blackened non-growing state.
baseline_models.mechanism: The adjacent roots produce a temporal inversion: dawn does not simply illuminate the result; it reveals something resembling the darkness dawn normally cuts away, or a day itself cut short.

activation_trace.role: Dawn and the opening of morning supply the bright temporal threshold.
Night and day cutting each other off, together with blackening and failed growth, supplies the paradoxical dark counterpart to dawn.

changed_reading.before: Morning merely dates the discovery of a dark ruin.
changed_reading.after: Morning performs a reversal: the opening of light discloses a blackened counter-day, as though the coming day or the subject's future had itself been cut off.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The comparison noun at word 2 includes a milk channel cut or dried and the final remnant reached at exhaustion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The simile can transfer bodily and hydraulic failure to the subject: not only its visible crop but its capacity to issue nourishment has ceased at the channel.

activation_trace.role: A dried or damaged milk channel supplies the image of productive flow stopped at its source.
The last remnant at exhaustion supplies finality: output has reached its terminal remainder.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports loss of what was present.
changed_reading.after: The verse may report loss of generative capacity itself: the source has been dried, and no further yield can pass through.

context_deltas.mechanism: The owners bind themselves to a morning harvest, but an encircling visitor arrives while they sleep; the focus then presents their intended predicate as an already completed state. Their expedition is preempted by a counter-harvest or dawn raid whose agency is reversed.

activation_trace.role: The completed crop-cutting image is the result whose missing agent the surrounding sequence supplies.
The morning-raid image turns ordinary dawn into a preemptive incursion against the planned morning expedition.
A binding oath supplies the owners' committed plan and fixes the intended human agency.
The planned cutting is specifically agricultural harvesting, providing the action later found already realized.
Morning opening fixes the owners' intended time and makes the focus repetition a temporal echo.
A passing visitation supplies the intervening agency that reaches the crop before its owners do.
Literal sleep removes the planners from the action interval and enables the agency reversal.

structural_cues: 68:17 places the same harvest and morning roots in an unrealized human plan before their focus-verse realization.
68:19-20 orders visitation, sleeping owners, and a fa-marked completed result before the owners can act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an oath-bound morning harvest, an intervening visitation, sleep, and an achieved harvested likeness. Reader: the planned action is fulfilled against the planners by reversed agency. Alternative: the event may be simple destruction that only resembles harvest, without a transferred agent-role.

changed_reading.before: The subject merely resembles a field after harvest.
changed_reading.after: The owners' own harvest plan has been preemptively executed upon their possession: they awaken not as harvesters but as those from whom the completed harvest has been taken.

context_deltas.mechanism: A program of withholding good, admitting no exception, and barring the poor is materialized as severance. The boundary intended to keep a claimant from the crop reverses direction and cuts the owners themselves off from it.

activation_trace.role: Severance supplies the reversible relation between possessor and produce, not only physical crop damage.
Holding the hand back from giving supplies the social action that the garden episode renders materially.
Excluding an item from a whole supplies the owners' refusal to leave any protected share or exception.
Entry into an interior supplies the access that the owners explicitly intend to block.
The abasement of poverty identifies the excluded claimant whose deprivation motivates the boundary.
Withholding and constriction supply the owners' purposeful closed posture as they approach.
Missing the desired thing names the recognized endpoint of the reversed exclusion.

structural_cues: 68:18 and 68:24 move from no exception to no entry, tightening an exclusionary boundary before the focus result.
68:27 corrects a navigation diagnosis into a relation of deprivation: the owners are cut off from what they expected to possess.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: repeated withholding, exception, entry, poverty, and deprivation cues around a severed result. Reader: the intended exclusion rebounds so that the owners occupy the excluded position. Alternative: the sequence can be read as punishment for intent without a precise reversal of the access relation.

changed_reading.before: The crop itself has been physically cut off.
changed_reading.after: The decisive cut is relational: those who meant to sever the poor from the yield are themselves severed from possession and access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden is lexically an enclosure hidden by dense growth. Cutting converts that covered identity into a detached, exposed tract, so the owners' first visual response can be failure to recognize the place before they diagnose deprivation.

activation_trace.role: The detached harvested tract supplies the exposed residual form left after the enclosure is stripped.
A garden covered and hidden by its trees supplies the pre-event spatial identity that cutting abolishes.
Loss of the sought thing supplies the first diagnosis that the familiar place or object cannot be found.
Direct visual perception makes the recognition failure a response to altered form rather than absent information.
Open space without cover supplies a later spatial analogue for what remains when a protected enclosure is stripped.

structural_cues: 68:17 names the pre-event object by a form associated with concealment; 68:20 replaces it with a cut-tract comparison.
68:26 sequences seeing, misrecognition, and then corrected recognition of deprivation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a tree-covered enclosure, a cut tract, sight, loss-language, and later exposed open ground. Reader: removal of the vegetal screen erases the object's recognizable garden-form. Alternative: the speakers' first diagnosis may simply mean that they took the wrong route.

changed_reading.before: A recognizable garden has been damaged.
changed_reading.after: The event has de-gardened the garden: its covering, enclosure, and visual identity are cut away so completely that the owners initially cannot map the exposed tract to the place they knew.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch that joins temporal darkness with burn-blackening is activated by the earlier metal-assay/fire cluster and the episode's explicit test framing. The altered surface becomes diagnostic: matter displays the owners' previously hidden condition.

activation_trace.role: Blackening, non-growth, and night/day cutoff supply the visible dark result that can function as an assay mark.
Testing metal or a person supplies the assay mechanism by which an inner condition becomes knowable.
Fire and its blackening supply the material bridge from testing to the focus verse's darkened result.
A test that makes a condition manifest frames the entire garden sequence as disclosure rather than random loss.

structural_cues: 68:6 asks which party bears the tested or afflicted condition before 68:17 explicitly frames the garden event as a test.
The focus juxtaposes morning disclosure with a branch that can hold both darkness and burn-blackening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: assay, fire-blackening, a test that manifests condition, and a blackened focus image. Reader: the material result externalizes the owners' concealed moral state. Alternative: al-sarim may denote night or harvested ground with no implication of burning or diagnostic mirroring.

changed_reading.before: The blackened likeness is evidence of what happened to the garden.
changed_reading.after: The blackened likeness is also assay evidence of who the owners have become or shown themselves to be: their inward withholding is developed onto the landscape.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah places an uncut, undiminished reward against the focus image of provision reaching a severed end, while later placing gardens of good condition beyond the ruined tract. The focus becomes one pole in a cut-versus-uncut economy of yield.

activation_trace.role: The final remnant at exhaustion supplies provision that has reached its terminal limit.
Cutting or diminishing until extension ends supplies the negated counterpart: a reward explicitly characterized as not terminating this way.
Good condition and sustained favor supply the positive garden-state contrasted with exhausted yield.

structural_cues: 68:3 negates termination from reward, whereas the focus comparison foregrounds termination and exhaustion.
68:34 restores garden imagery on the side of enduring good condition after 68:33 names the ruined episode as punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an explicitly uncut reward, a terminal focus image, and later gardens of favor. Reader: these form an intentional antithesis between continuing and terminated provision. Alternative: the earlier term may emphasize reward without reproach rather than without temporal end.

changed_reading.after: The ended crop embodies cut provision and is set against a mode of reward whose defining extension is not cut; the verse therefore contrasts economies, not only landscapes.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the material cutoff, the group turns face-to-face, blames itself, seeks to clear its Lord of wrong, and redirects desire toward replacement. The cut therefore ends one moral interval and opens another rather than functioning only as a terminal endpoint.

activation_trace.role: One temporal period cutting off another supplies a threshold model for the group's before-and-after stance.
Clearing and exonerating supplies the corrective speech the group had omitted before the loss.
Face-to-face confrontation supplies the social reorientation produced after the isolated plan fails.
Mutual blame supplies explicit reassessment of the conduct preceding the cutoff.
One thing standing in place of another supplies a future beyond the apparently terminal ruined state.
Desire turning toward or away supplies the group's redirected orientation after recognition.

structural_cues: 68:26-32 progresses from visual confusion to deprivation, correction, confession, mutual blame, and redirected hope.
The day/night branch of the focus noun allows an ending to be simultaneously a boundary into a new interval.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the ruined threshold is followed by correction, confrontation, blame, replacement, and redirected desire. Reader: the material severance enables a moral phase change. Alternative: their speech may be momentary crisis language and need not establish durable transformation.

changed_reading.after: Al-sarim also marks a hinge: it cuts off the group's prior closed orientation and makes self-recognition and a redirected future possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later questions connect making one class like another, judging, and written proof. They reactivate the focus syntax of becoming-like: the transformed material state can be read as an executed classification, a verdict made visible rather than a neutral visual comparison.

activation_trace.role: Becoming into a state supplies the focus verse's material act of classification.
Causing something to become a state supplies a later parallel to the focus transformation.
Judgment between parties supplies the adjudicative force assigned to the transformed state.
A written fixing that obligates a judgment supplies the model of a verdict made durable and inspectable.

structural_cues: The focus uses a becoming-plus-comparison construction; 68:35 asks whether one class is to be made like another.
68:36-39 repeatedly challenges the basis and manner of judgment, with the branchless interrogative cue at 68:36 used only structurally.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: parallel state-making, comparison, judgment, and written obligation. Reader: the focus likeness is an enacted verdict that classifies through matter. Alternative: the later forensic questions may not retrospectively alter the earlier simile's function.

changed_reading.before: Like al-sarim is a visual description of aftermath.
changed_reading.after: Like al-sarim is also a material sentence: the subject is made to display the category that judges the owners' attempted cutting and exclusion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence joins unperceived stepwise taking, extended respite, and firm strategy. It reopens the focus's compressed morning transition: the sudden visible result may be the disclosure point of a process whose completion was hidden during an interval, not proof that causation itself was instantaneous.

activation_trace.role: Morning opening supplies the threshold at which an unseen condition becomes visible.
Completed becoming supplies the compressed resultant state without specifying the duration of its production.
Taking degree by degree supplies a hidden incremental causal model behind an abrupt recognized endpoint.
Extended time and respite supply the interval in which the endpoint can mature unnoticed.
Strategic indirection supplies intentional concealment of the process until its effect is secure.

structural_cues: The focus states only a morning result, while 68:19 locates the owners in sleep during the causal interval.
68:44 explicitly pairs gradual taking with lack of awareness before 68:45 adds temporal extension.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: sleep, a morning endpoint, stepwise taking without knowledge, respite, and strategy. Reader: sudden perception is separated from potentially gradual hidden production. Alternative: the later warning is a distinct general mechanism and the garden event itself may have been instantaneous.

changed_reading.before: The verb means the destruction happened suddenly at dawn.
changed_reading.after: The verb certifies a completed state at dawn; dawn may be the instant of disclosure, while the cutting developed unseen across the preceding interval.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The activation is surprising because it crosses from ص ر م to the branch inventory of ج ر م, but both inventories explicitly converge on cutting, harvest, and dry harvest residue, while 68:22 names the owners as would-be cutters and 68:35 names the contrasted criminal class. It remains anchored in the focus harvest/severance noun; downstream prose should present the agent-patient collapse as a lexical echo, not as an etymological identity between the roots.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus subject is made like the cut or harvested result at word 2; the context first assigns cutting to the owners and later supplies a cutter/criminal branch cluster.

activation_trace.role: Severing supplies the patient-state into which the would-be agents' possession is transformed.
Harvesting supplies the action-result shared by the owners' plan and the ruined field.
Decisive resolve supplies the owners' self-positioning as active cutters immediately after the result already exists.
Cutting and harvesting supply a branch-level shadow behind the later criminal-class label.
Dry residue left by harvest supplies a material portrait of the cutter as the waste-state his cutting produces.

changed_reading.before: The owners intend to be cutters, while the garden passively becomes cut.
changed_reading.after: The cut residue becomes a portrait of the cutter: attempted agency rebounds until the would-be harvesters are classified through the patient-state their own action sought to create.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a deliberately cross-domain activation: descriptions attached to compromise, baseness, harshness, and resolve unexpectedly cluster around weak milk, non-fertilizing water, infertility, and cut milk or rain. The focus inventory itself licenses the stopped-milk channel, so the model remains materially anchored; downstream prose should call it a body-ecology analogy for failed yield, not claim that the verse literally depicts an animal or a specific irrigation failure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2 can image a camel whose milk channel is cut or dried, allowing crop failure to be modeled as generative flow failure.

activation_trace.role: A cut or dried milk channel supplies the core model of nourishment unable to pass from source to recipient.
Little milk and weakness supply an early attenuation of productive flow.
A small weak water supply that cannot fertilize extends attenuation from body to ecology.
A strong but non-conceiving camel supplies potency decoupled from generative outcome.
Interruption of milk and rain fuses social withholding with bodily and agricultural flow cessation.

changed_reading.before: The standing crop has been removed or burned.
changed_reading.after: The whole productive ecology has become non-yielding: strength may remain, but milk, water, fertility, and produce no longer traverse their channels.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is surprising because it lets the surah's pen, line, and written-judgment branches spatialize the focus tract as though a cutting stroke had excised it. It remains anchored in the focus branch of a detached land-piece and in packet branches that explicitly join pen-cutting to a cut parcel and line-making to a cutting stroke. Downstream prose should retain the language of 'as though' and avoid claiming a literal inscription on the ground.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The comparison noun at word 2 can denote a piece cut away from a larger terrain, including harvested land.

activation_trace.role: A detached land-piece supplies the focus result as a parcel visibly cut out from its surroundings.
A cut section of land supplies the spatial bridge from the pen's cutting family to the isolated focus tract.
A line formed by striking or cutting supplies the imagined boundary-stroke that separates the parcel.
Written fixing that imposes judgment supplies the verdict-like force tentatively assigned to the cut boundary.

changed_reading.before: The ruin is an undifferentiated patch of damaged ground.
changed_reading.after: The ruin resembles an excised parcel, as though a cutting line had written the owners' judgment into the terrain by separating their plot from ordinary continuity.

strongest_changes: The intended morning harvest is discovered as a completed counter-harvest: agency has reversed while the planners slept.
The owners' attempted exclusion rebounds as their own severance from access and possession.
The garden loses not just produce but its covered garden-form, making the exposed tract initially unrecognizable.
The later cutter/criminal branch cluster lets the cut residue become an exploratory material portrait of the would-be cutters.
summary.what_was_special: The two-word focus verse behaves as a dense switchyard: dawn, becoming, severance, harvest, blackness, detached land, exhausted flow, and temporal succession remain simultaneously live. Context does not collapse them; it distributes them across reversed agency, social exclusion, visual recognition, assay, judgment, repentance, and hidden temporal process.
remaining_uncertainties: The al-sarim comparison can privilege harvested ground, night-blackness, burn-blackening, or generic severance without the focus verse itself selecting one.
The moral-pivot reading depends on treating the post-loss speech as genuine reorientation rather than temporary crisis response.
The gradual-process model is abductively supported by later stepwise-taking language but need not describe the garden event's physical duration.
The infertility and written-parcel models are branch-backed cross-domain activations and should remain explicitly exploratory.
